Panel template — round 1

One shape every side panel and tab fills in: the Concordance, the dictionary, a verse alone, search, the notebook. Drawn with the app's tokens only. Every verse is a wb text answer (data/verses.txt). The words "zeal" and the counts are a sample lookup, not anyone's study.

P1 · The anatomy

Five bands, top to bottom. Only the head and the body are always there; the way back, the tools row and the foot appear when a panel needs them.

Sorted in Bible order
tab strip (the dock's, unchanged) ① the way back — only when opened from a verse ② kind — small caps label, what this panel is ③ title + the panel's own icon buttons (≤ 2, then More) ④ subtitle — counts, scope, one line ⑤ tools row — switches and filters, never actions ⑥ body — section labels, rows, cards ⑦ foot — at most one or two actions on the whole panel

P2 · What a tab shows at its top — three ways

The open question: how much room the head takes. Each is drawn on the same content.

P2a · Title block (as P1)
Verse

Numbers 25:11

KJV

Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.

Most room to say what this is; scrolls away with the body. Closest to today's .pane-head.

P2b · One slim bar that stays

Numbers 25:11

KJV

Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.

One line, pinned while the body scrolls. Tightest; no room for a kind label or counts.

P2c · Block that shrinks to the bar
Verse

Numbers 25:11

KJV

Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.

Full title at rest; once scrolled, the title moves into the top line beside the icons (as P2b). Most work to build.

P3 · Buttons — one ladder for every panel

Four kinds, each with one job. A panel shows at most one primary at a time.

Icon button — the panel's own tools in the head (Keep, More), 30 px, no border
Quiet — links that go somewhere: Open in reader, Show all 16, Back to the verse
Button — an action on this panel's content
Primary — the one thing the panel is for, when there is one (Save, Make the document)
Switch and chips — the tools row; they change what is shown, never the study
EnglishHebrewGreek  zeal zealous zealously

P4 · Text — which style says what

The token styles already exist; this fixes which one each kind of text in a panel uses. Scripture is always Literata; everything of the app's and the person's is Inter.

TitleNumbers 25:11--type-title · one per panel
Kind / section labelConcordance · English--type-label, muted
Subtitle, counts16 places · Old and New Testament--type-small, muted
ReferenceJohn 2:17--type-small-strong, accent · always a link back
Scripture in a panelThe zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.--type-read-small · from John 2:17, verbatim
The person's writingMy note on this verse.--type-body
Lookup text (BDB, Webster's)an entry's definition, as printed--type-small at 14/22
Times, counts, parsing3 days ago · 16--type-caption, muted
